notes: Diff of 328 lines over 9 functions, read in full. Neutral changes: setEnforcedOptions' EnforcedOptionSet log is now one slice mem[mem[64] len v - mem[64]] instead of three raw pieces. In lzReceiveAndRevert the pointer copies (_13, _20) are replaced by mem[64], which no longer moves because the dead free-pointer updates are dropped. The offsets are adjusted consistently, but 'mem[mem[64] + mem[mem[64]]]' reads slightly worse than 'mem[_13 + mem[_13]]'. Both loops (lzReceiveAndRevert's and _setEnforcedOptions') are unchanged.
summary: No regression. Parameter names now follow calldata words, and returns, selectors and bubbled reverts are decoded. The immutable artifact remains.
